slides.title: The Purpose of Navigate Is More Important Now
slides.content: By Year 2: Applications are approaching. Major assessments are taking place. Evidence matters more. Your Digital CV should now be demonstrating real achievements and growth.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'The Purpose of Navigate Is More Important Now'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on The Purpose of Navigate Is More Important Now.

slides.title: Your Skills Assessment Should Drive Development
slides.content: Use the assessment to: Identify weaknesses. Set priorities. Track progress. Gather evidence of improvement. Amber areas often provide the best opportunities for growth.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Your Skills Assessment Should Drive Development'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Your Skills Assessment Should Drive Development.

slides.title: Your Destination Must Be Specific
slides.content: You should know: Where you want to go next. Relevant entry requirements. Qualification expectations. Deadlines and timelines. Vague ambitions become problems in Year 2.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Your Destination Must Be Specific'? Select all that apply.
options: Where you want to go next
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Your Destination Must Be Specific.

slides.title: Career Investigation Must Be Realistic
slides.content: Research careers carefully: Daily responsibilities. Working conditions. Progression routes. Required skills. Discovering that a career is not for you is valuable information.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Career Investigation Must Be Realistic'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Career Investigation Must Be Realistic.

slides.title: Your Digital CV Should Contain Evidence
slides.content: Evidence might include: Final projects. Industry placements. Professional work. Creative productions. Technical projects. External competitions. Industry visits. Part-time jobs. Evidence should demonstrate skills and development.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following is a key point about 'Your Digital CV Should Contain Evidence'?
exercise.explanation: This is a key point from the section on Your Digital CV Should Contain Evidence.

slides.title: Reflection Is a Professional Skill
slides.content: Strong reflection: Analyses decisions. Identifies causes. Evaluates outcomes. Explains improvements. Professional portfolios require analytical reflection rather than simple description.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Reflection Is a Professional Skill'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Reflection Is a Professional Skill.

slides.title: Logging Activities Saves Time Later
slides.content: Regular updates create: Better portfolios. Better personal statements. Better applications. Better evidence of employability. Ten minutes now can save hours later.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Logging Activities Saves Time Later'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Logging Activities Saves Time Later.

slides.title: Independence Is Expected
slides.content: Year 2 students are expected to: Manage deadlines. Complete Navigate independently. Ask for help early when needed. Track progress consistently. Professional behaviour includes requesting support before problems become major barriers.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Independence Is Expected'? Select all that apply.
options: Ask for help early when needed
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Independence Is Expected.

slides.title: Quick Revision Summary
slides.content: Key points to remember: Use Navigate as evidence for progression Refine career and destination plans Log everything consistently Develop high-quality reflections Build a professional portfolio Take responsibility for your own progress and seek support early when needed. ,
